blocks.text: Bear Creek Green Timbers homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Bear Creek Green Timbers, September 2026. Detached houses: 93 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 5% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 37 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 32 sold over 4 months against an average of 86.5 listed, about 10.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 16 sold. Condos and townhomes: 15 sold over 4 months against an average of 36.0 listed, about 9.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 6 sold.

faq.q: Can a house here add a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: One secondary suite per dwelling unit (habitable floor area at most 40% of the principal dwelling unit, never inside a coach house or garden suite), a coach house or garden suite of 35–75 m² (up to 120 m² on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots below maximum FAR, with lane access required for a coach house on smaller lots), and 3–4 SSMUH units on most lots by size band, up to 6 near a frequent bus stop (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: When does SkyTrain reach Green Timbers?
faq.a: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain project names Green Timbers Station at 140 Street and Fraser Highway, on the westernmost edge of Green Timbers Urban Forest, among its eight stations, and TransLink states an anticipated in-service date of 2029 for the 16-kilometre Expo Line extension from King George Station to Langley City.
